flagship_intro: Selected engineering work spanning quantitative trading infrastructure, real-time market data, performance optimization, and cloud-based trading systems.
artifacts_intro: Supporting projects and engineering utilities built across APIs, data extraction, automation, and developer tooling.

flagship_systems.title: High-Performance Algorithmic Trading & Backtesting Infrastructure
flagship_systems.context: The trading platform required a more scalable architecture as the firm expanded its trading capabilities across Indian, Crypto, and FX markets, while large financial-data workloads created significant memory overhead.
constraints: Improving scalability of the existing trading stack
Reducing memory overhead in data-intensive workloads
Maintaining a modular quantitative architecture while introducing performance-oriented components
flagship_systems.architecture_summary: Led a major rewrite of the trading stack using C#, .NET, and unmanaged C++ interoperability. Introduced memory-mapped files and blittable structs for more efficient data handling and integrated SignalR for real-time market data streaming to web dashboards.

decisions.title: Memory-Mapped Data Handling
decisions.detail: Used memory-mapped files to work with large financial datasets more efficiently and reduce conventional managed-memory overhead.

decisions.title: Blittable Structs
decisions.detail: Applied compact value-type data structures to improve memory efficiency and reduce unnecessary allocation overhead.

decisions.title: Managed / Unmanaged Interoperability
decisions.detail: Integrated unmanaged C++ components with the C#/.NET architecture where lower-level performance capabilities were required.

decisions.title: Real-Time Dashboard Integration
decisions.detail: Integrated SignalR to stream market data from the trading infrastructure into web-based dashboards.

evidence.label: Memory usage reduced by approximately 80% through memory-mapped files and blittable structs.

flagship_systems.title: Real-Time Market Data Distribution Pipeline
flagship_systems.context: Real-time stock market tick and quote data needed to be distributed reliably across a large client base while maintaining very low delivery delay.
constraints: Handling real-time market data flow with minimal delay
Supporting distribution to hundreds of downstream clients
Maintaining reliable communication across the streaming pipeline
flagship_systems.architecture_summary: Built real-time market data streaming infrastructure using low-level socket programming and distributed the resulting tick and quote data to client applications and web-based consumers.

decisions.title: Low-Level Socket Programming
decisions.detail: Used low-level socket programming to provide direct control over real-time market-data communication.

decisions.title: Real-Time Data Distribution
decisions.detail: Designed the streaming flow to publish live tick and quote information to a broad set of downstream consumers.

decisions.title: Web Dashboard Integration
decisions.detail: Connected real-time market data infrastructure with web-facing distribution through SignalR and related streaming components.

evidence.label: Real-time stock market tick and quote data delivered to hundreds of clients with less than 10ms delay.

flagship_systems.title: Dynamic Cloud Trading Migration & Infrastructure Optimization
flagship_systems.context: The trading infrastructure required a more efficient cloud-based operating model as the system evolved and trading workloads expanded.
constraints: Supporting migration of trading workloads into a cloud environment
Improving operational efficiency without compromising trading-system support
flagship_systems.architecture_summary: Developed and deployed a dynamic system for cloud-based trading migration, focusing on more efficient infrastructure utilization and operational support.

decisions.title: Dynamic Cloud Migration
decisions.detail: Designed a migration approach that adapted cloud infrastructure to the operational requirements of the trading environment.

decisions.title: Infrastructure Optimization
decisions.detail: Focused on reducing unnecessary infrastructure expenditure while improving the efficiency of supporting trading workloads.

decisions.title: Operational Efficiency
decisions.detail: Improved the operational support model alongside the infrastructure migration.

evidence.label: Operational costs reduced by 98.8% while improving support efficiency.
